name: kmp-project-template
description: The Kotlin Multiplatform Multi-module Template generator simplifies cross-platform development by enabling shared business logic and UI components across Android, iOS, Desktop, and Web, while retaining native platform functionality.

paragraphs: An open-source, brand-neutral white-label template for Kotlin Multiplatform. Every brand-touching value ships as a placeholder (com.example.app / "App Toolkit"); fill app-profile/, run ./gradlew syncForkConfig, and it flows to every platform. The bundled demo features (loan tracking, bill reminders, interest-rate watching, calculators, macro indicators) showcase the 8 Store5 archetypes. See the canonical fork loop.

\[!Note] This branch is designed for partial customized projects. Running the customizer.sh script doesn't rename any application module, instead it'll change all core and feature module namespaces, packages, and other related configurations accordingly. For full customization, please use the full-customizable branch instead.
features: B1 Loan Tracker — track personal loans, principal remaining, EMI, due dates
B2 EMI Calculator — compute monthly installments for any loan
B3 Affordability — "how much loan can I afford?" planner
B4 Bill Reminders — recurring bills + in-app notification scheduler
B5 Amortization — full payment schedule per loan
